Admin.description: Configures the admin area of Orchard Core. The values can also be defined per tenant under 'OrchardCore:{TenantName}:Admin'. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Admin/.

AdminUrlPrefix.description: The URL prefix used to access the admin area, e.g. 'MyAdmin' to serve the admin area from '/MyAdmin'. Leading and trailing spaces and slashes are removed.

List.description: The defaults of the admin lists, e.g. the content items list. An administrator can override them from Configuration > Settings > Admin. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Admin/#admin-list-layouts.

DefaultLayout.description: How the items of a list are rendered. 'List' renders each item whole, 'Grid' renders one column per column of the list. A theme or a module can add other layouts.

DefaultActionsLayout.description: How the actions of each row are rendered: 'Buttons', or 'Menu' for a single compact dropdown.

AllowUserSelection.description: Whether each list shows a selector with the available layouts. A user's choice is kept in a cookie, per list, and applies to that user only.

OrchardCore_Admin.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Admin' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Admin' instead.
